mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS is increasing and UNRATE is decreasing.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is a negative signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a shift towards a service-oriented economy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 is increasing and INDPRO is decreasing.
